title: Dongtan New Town
year_note: First residents in Dongtan 1 (not a single construction date)
description: Dongtan is a planned urban landscape shaped by large-scale development, branded apartment complexes, infrastructures and the relationship between the Korean state, consumers and industrial conglomerates. The pin is an approximate reference point for an extensive new town, not a surveyed building coordinate.

title: Maine–Montparnasse
year_note: Shopping centre opened in 1972; property complex built 1969–1973
description: The Maine–Montparnasse commercial complex is the site of ARTIFICE's architectural project La machine du dialogue, which proposes turning commercial infrastructure into a civic forum.

title: Bercy 2
description: Designed by Renzo Piano and Jean-François Blassel, Bercy 2 is a large shopping centre on the edge of Paris, recognizable by its curved metal-clad roof.

title: Le Millénaire
description: This large shopping centre along the Canal Saint-Denis was developed as part of the redevelopment of the Porte d'Aubervilliers area.

title: Gangbyeon Techno Mart
description: A large electronics shopping complex and office tower in Gwangjin-gu, developed during the late 1990s and associated with a new model of retail infrastructure.

title: Nakano Broadway
description: An integrated shopping and residential complex from Japan's era of rapid economic growth, later associated with anime, collecting and subcultural commerce.
